description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_CacheResource_File, which manages file system caching for Smarty templates, including methods for populating cache metadata, reading, writing, clearing cache, and handling cache locks.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_CacheResource_File
classes.description: Manages file system caching for Smarty templates, including cache population, reading, writing, clearing, and lock management.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates cached object with metadata from the resource, including filepath and timestamp.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Updates cached object with timestamp and existence status.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads and processes the cached template content, executing or including the cache file.

methods.name: writeCachedContent
methods.description: Writes rendered template output to cache and manages cache invalidation.

methods.name: readCachedContent
methods.description: Reads cached template content from the cache file.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all cache files managed by this resource.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears cache files for a specific template resource.

methods.name: hasLock
methods.description: Checks if the cache for a template is currently locked.

methods.name: acquireLock
methods.description: Locks the cache for a template to prevent concurrent modifications.

methods.name: releaseLock
methods.description: Releases the cache lock for a template.
